nodes.text: Choose this character’s unused Normal, Heroic or Mythic Nighthold save yourself. For the direct Raid Finder alternative, speak to Archmage Timear in Legion Dalaran and request Betrayer’s Rise instead; that queue starts at Gul’dan.

recovery.text: The LFR wing and each standard difficulty are separate opportunities. A Mythic instance ID is a specific shared save; never accept or change it automatically.

nodes.choiceText: Choose the direct Betrayer’s Rise Raid Finder walkthrough

nodes.text: For a full standard run, enter the building at Suramar 43.3,62.3 and descend the underground passages/teleports. At the summoning stone take the right-hand route into the Nighthold, not the left route into the Arcway.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

destination.label: Underground Nighthold approach
destination.directions: Descend from the building. At the summoning stone turn right for the raid.

nodes.text: Follow the aqueduct route to Skorpyron. Defeat him, sheltering behind the crystal fragments for Shockwave if the encounter lasts long enough.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue along the aqueduct into the Chronomatic Anomaly chamber. If Power Overwhelming blocks progress, kill a Waning Time Particle, take its Temporal Charge and use Temporal Smash on the boss.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the adjoining passage into Trilliax’s room. Defeat the construct, move with the Annihilation beam and clear required room hazards before using the way onward.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: In the central royal area, find Spellblade Aluriel’s patrol and defeat her. Keep the ice/fire/arcane marks away from other players until their indicated interaction is needed; handle the animated enchantments.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Take the route up Astromancer’s Rise into the Eternal Observatory for Star Augur Etraeus. Complete his changing celestial phases; handle the summoned void creature when it protects him.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Return to the royal area and take the Shal’dorei Terrace branch to High Botanist Tel’arn. Defeat the split forms, kill parasitic adds and leave the expanding Controlled Chaos circles.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Return to the central area and take the southeast Shattered Walkway to Krosus. Stay off the Fel Beam side, handle Slam circles with your group and move back from each bridge section before it collapses.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Backtrack to the Captain’s Quarters in the southwest and defeat Tichondrius. Shelter behind Fel Spires during Echoes of the Void; in his night phase kill bats and avoid the incoming nightmare attacks.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: After all eight earlier bosses are defeated, use the newly accessible Nightspire route. Speak to the available Image of Khadgar/teleport control where needed and enter Elisande’s chamber. Complete her time rewinds; cross Arcanetic Rings through the slowed sections near the time zones.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: From Elisande’s chamber, take the route to the rooftop Font of Night. Defeat Gul’dan’s opening lieutenants, then Gul’dan; remove Eyes before they multiply, move out of Fel Efflux and handle Bonds of Fel with the group. Mythic continues into The Demon Within: finish that additional encounter rather than leaving after Gul’dan falls.

recovery.text: If the roof route or encounter is locked, check every earlier boss and the selected save. On Mythic, wait for and finish the extra phase. Combat suitability is not inferred from level; use a suitable group if required.

nodes.text: Loot the completed Gul’dan encounter for Golden Hearthstone Card: Lord Jaraxxus. The target is a random toy drop; each eligible character/difficulty attempt remains separate.

recovery.text: Check all encounter loot and bag space. A kill, cinematic or achievement does not prove the toy dropped; use the game’s current lockout evidence before planning another attempt.

nodes.writtenDestination: Nighthold, Font of Night: after Elisande unlocks the final ascent/teleport, complete Gul’dan’s rooftop encounter and loot it here. Mythic’s extra encounter must also finish.

nodes.text: Use Golden Hearthstone Card: Lord Jaraxxus from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
